Managed Portfolio Business Case Approval
Summary
Minerds Bell is a South Australia based financial advisory firm with a strong legacy, having operated for over 50
years. The business is presently led by Andrew Harris (Principal), who succeeded his father, alongside directors
Natalie Bordun and Daran Thompson. The team comprises five financial advisers—one of whom is also a
mortgage broker—supported by a practice manager, two paraplanners, and five administrative staff. North is the
preferred investment platform, and the business continues to grow organically, primarily through client referrals.
Current State and Opportunity
Despite its success, the firm’s current operational model is labour-intensive, with Andrew managing an average
of 15 investments per client. This complexity increases the risk of implementation errors and places a significant
administrative burden on the office. As a result, advisers have less capacity to focus on new business
development and client acquisition.
Proposal
We propose forming an investment sales partnership to build two Built portfolios – 0% growth and 100% growth -
- processes and enhance efficiency. Expected inflows to continue to be $35 million with increased potential with
business efficiency improving, and the overall committed FUA to SMA will be $300 million over the next two
years.
